title: Pocket prep: product↔eng sync (API / Console / Dedicated / Private)
content:
Quick context:
- 20m sync with Jordan (eng lead) — keep it lean. Primary goal: unblock Dedicated capacity plan and confirm Console timeline for canary + opt-in UI for private customers.
- Top priority signals: customer trial conversion (hosted→dedicated), Console telemetry for rollout, infra cost delta for small–mid customers choosing Dedicated vs Hosted.

Agenda (rough order, time boxed):
1) 3m - Quick wins & blockers (what I need from Jordan today)
2) 6m - Dedicated capacity plan: numbers, risk, fallback
3) 5m - Console changes & launch gating (canary schedule, opt-in toggle, telemetry hooks)
4) 3m - Private deployments: onboarding checklist, infra checklist, security sign-offs
5) 3m - Action review & decisions (owners + dates)

Talking points / prep notes:
- Dedicated capacity
  - Ask: can we commit to 2x baseline throughput for Tier-A customers by EOW? Jordan expects kernel tuning + q8 quantization to free ~30% GPU cycles.
  - Risk: autoscaler flapping during morning spikes — need guardrails. Proposal: temporary soft quota (prevent autoscale down below reservation) + manual override for 24h after deploy.
  - Metric to watch after change: p95 latency, token/s GPU utilization, queue length.
  - My ask of eng: estimate effort (dev+test+deploy) in next 48h; if >3d, we pivot to config-only approach.

- Console rollouts (canary + opt-in)
  - Key product deliverable: opt-in toggle for Dedicated customers in Console; must surface expected latency/cost delta and link to docs.
  - Need: telemetry event: console.opt_in_dedicated (user_id, org, before_config, after_config). Ask Jordan to confirm event schema and who owns instrumentation PR.
  - UX concern: default state — should default be OFF until SLA/commit visible? Ops wants default OFF for enterprise.
  - Decide in-call: default OFF + in-console warning modal (copy: "Reserved capacity may change cost/latency. Confirm you want to reserve X GPUs.").

- Private deployments (VPC / on-prem)
  - Onboarding checklist gaps flagged by solutions-eng: missing KMS/HSM doc and network diagram for the infra team. I will own doc but need eng to review the KMS section.
  - Security sign-offs: need SRE + infra to confirm audit log retention is configurable per-customer. Jordan, can you confirm feasibility and rough timeline?

- Cross-cutting ops/cost items
  - Short-term optimization: suggest a quick audit of batch size defaults across models (particularly for chat endpoints) — could save 10–18% token cost. Who owns this? (Maya flagged as potential owner).
  - Ask Jordan: can we add a short-running job to sample real traffic and report optimal batching per route? Estimate: 1 engineer, 2–3 days.

Notes to self / one-off reminders:
- Keep the conversation solution-oriented — offer product compromises (e.g., feature flags, config knobs) instead of scope creep.
- If Jordan pushes back on engineering capacity, surface the customer revenue impact (trial → paid conversion figures).
- Bring up support backlog: critical items blocking Dedicated customers (ticket IDs prefixed SPT-).

Open questions to close in the call:
- Which telemetry owner will own the console.opt_in_dedicated event? (engineering infra or console frontend?)
- Exact definition of "Tier-A" capacity target — confirm numbers for SLAs (tokens/s per org).
- Can audit log retention be changed without DB migration for existing customers?

Draft decisions I want by EOD after the sync (and my fallback if not):
1) Decision: opt-in toggle default (target: OFF). Fallback: if no consensus, default OFF and capture decision in Jira.
2) Decision: dedicated capacity soft-gating approach (target: implement soft quota + manual override). Fallback: schedule config-only mitigation for next deploy.
3) Decision: telemetry event owner (target: infra team). Fallback: product will create schema and assign owner in Jira.

Action items (capture during call) — sample template I will paste live:
- ACTION: Jordan to post ETA (hrs) for kernel tuning + quantization changes — due 2026-03-14 (owner: Jordan Lee)
- ACTION: Maya to prototype traffic-sampling job for batch size recommendation — due 2026-03-18 (owner: Maya Rivera)
- ACTION: Kai to draft KMS/HSM section and link network diagram for private onboarding doc — due 2026-03-15 (owner: Kai Nguyen)
summary: Lean 1:1 prep for product lead (Kai) before sync with eng lead (Jordan). Focused on Dedicated capacity, Console opt-in rollout, Private onboarding, telemetry and short-term cost optimizations. Contains agenda, asks, open questions and action-item templates.
